sar.narrative: Customer C07297, holder of card C07297-K1, is the subject of this suspicious activity report following an analyst request to review online transaction 3476602. Between 2016-11-21 20:00 and 2016-11-21 20:30, four online purchases totaling $1,906.07 were executed on the card using device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080'. The specific transactions and amounts comprised $478.95 (3476602, 2016-11-21 20:00), $456.96 (3476633, 2016-11-21 20:10), $488.04 (3476665, 2016-11-21 20:24), and $482.12 (3476682, 2016-11-21 20:30). Each amount was kept just under a $500 authorization threshold, and the purchases occurred within 30 minutes of each other. This activity is considered suspicious because the $478.95 transaction significantly exceeds the card's 95th percentile of $319.86 against a median of $60.73, and product code C had never been used on this card before. Furthermore, 8 of the 8 most similar closed cases, including CC-0031, CC-2079, CC-3235, and CC-3423, were confirmed fraud. Although a case-memory model score of 0.093 and a bank risk score of 0.26 showed dissimilarities to July-October confirmed fraud cases, the overall pattern indicates undocumented fraud with an exposure of $1,906.07. In response, the bank has executed an automatic escalation to an analyst and case creation, while recommending L1 approval to block the card and L2 approval to file this report.
